headline: TOR @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.47 at CHC 4.45, with a projected total of 8.92. The projected total climbed +0.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Dylan Cease has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, George Springer, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
